# User Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened and raised by a user.

## Scope note

Events directly originated by the human user, as distinct from AgentEvent, DeviceEvent, AppEvent, ToolEvent, and ServiceEvent.

## Broader

- [Event](../Event/) — generic (ISO 25964)
